device_metadata.title: LG X2 (2019)
device_metadata.timing_status: hypothesis requiring validation on this capture

diagnostics.interpretation: IQ correlation/impropriety can be modulation, not solely receiver imbalance; no automatic correction.

phase.status: Mixture phase increments; not verified DSI phase or calibrated PM. Amplitude mask is a heuristic, not a noise-calibrated probability.

spectrum.frequency_axis: signed baseband Hz, RF = stated center + baseband (IQ convention assumed)

stft.implementation: base MATLAB explicit STFT PSD fallback
base MATLAB explicit STFT PSD fallback
base MATLAB explicit STFT PSD fallback

periodicity.caveat: Autocorrelation maxima include harmonics, subharmonics and clutter. No unique row clock is established.

cyclic_probe.definition: abs mean{x[n] conj(x[n+lag]) exp(-j2pi alpha (n+lag/2)/Fs)} normalized by RMS powers

parametric.interpretation: Compare held-out errors and order stability; sharp AR peaks do not demonstrate screen information or true super-resolution.

frame_candidates.method: rectangular integration of |IQ| then candidate autocorrelation
frame_candidates.caveat: Finite data, rectangular-prefilter aliases, harmonics and interference can mimic frame peaks; validate with raster drift and independent acquisitions.

raster.interpolation: Catmull-Rom cubic; nearest control, no new measured bandwidth
raster.phase_fit: Select training rows before unwrapping; linear mixture-phase fit, otherwise global phase fallback
raster.validation_caveat: Row fit excludes validation-row phases, but horizontal alignment shares the full reference. Global fallback uses all rows. Frame 1 is self-reference, not validation.
raster.caveat: Repeatability and coherence can reward stable clutter. These are not ground-truth image fidelity, RGB recovery, or proof of LCD-driver origin.
